## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and active milestone task.

## Verification

- [ ] `make verify`
- [ ] Relevant golden files were intentionally regenerated and reviewed.
- [ ] Real-engine checks were run when execution behavior changed.
- [ ] The built wheel was tested when packaging or CLI behavior changed.

## Compatibility and governance

- [ ] Public contract, IR, evidence, and artifact compatibility is documented.
- [ ] An ADR or RFC is included when architecture or public contracts change.
- [ ] No secrets, generated build directories, or unrelated milestone work are included.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO sign-off (`Signed-off-by`).
